**Finding submitted: deviation (INDEMN)**

Article 12 has a genuinely mutual indemnity with standard procedure (12.2: notice, control of defence, participation, settlement consent, cooperation), and SFJ does indemnify the PB Indemnified Parties for its gross negligence/wilful misconduct, material breach, Protocol breach and AZ License breach. The failure is confined to IP:

- **SFJ's indemnity (12.1.1) has no IP infringement limb at all.**
- **Our indemnity (12.1.2)(f) covers infringement "by the Product or by either Party in performing its duties or obligations hereunder"** — so PB carries SFJ's own infringement risk, cut back only by a gross negligence/wilful misconduct/material breach carve-out.
- Article 11.3.2 confirms no counterparty IP indemnity sits elsewhere in the document.

Redline (validated, ok:true) makes the smallest symmetrical fix: a new 12.1.1(d-1) SFJ indemnity for third-party IP claims arising from SFJ's, its Affiliates' or Permitted Third Parties' performance, and 12.1.2(f) narrowed from "either Party" to PB and its Affiliates/Permitted Third Parties — preserving our indemnity for the Product itself, which is appropriate given PB supplies it.
